description: Ranks which sensors most likely drove a reported anomaly by z-score deviation from each sensor's own baseline, given a caller-supplied telemetry window. Fully deterministic, no LLM, no trained model. Statistical approximation inspired by Oswal et al. 2025 (kernel SHAP + TCAE) — not a SHAP/TCAE reimplementation. Price: $0.15 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

anomaly_event_id.description: Optional correlation ID, echoed back unchanged

top_k.description: How many ranked sensors to return

window.description: URL-encoded JSON array, max 20 entries: [{sensor_id, values[], baseline_mean?, baseline_stddev?}]

name: getRootCauseLocalization
title: Statistical Anomaly Attribution
